papers.title: Effect of Aging Temperature on Microstructure and Tensile Properties of Inconel 718 Fabricated by Selective Laser Melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Henan Materials Forming Equipment Intelligent Technology Engineering Research Center, Henan, 473000, China

corresponding_authors.name: Huang Jian-na
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Henan Materials Forming Equipment Intelligent Technology Engineering Research Center, Henan, 473000, China

papers.venue: Transactions of the Indian Institute of Metals

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是航空用Inconel 718合金，与生物医学方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure, no stress shielding, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration analysis; material is not biomedical.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究时效温度对SLM成形Inconel 718组织和性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 改变时效温度处理SLM样品并进行显微组织和拉伸测试
summary_zh.result: 时效温度显著影响析出相和拉伸性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸实验和显微组织观察验证

summary_en.motivation: Investigate the effect of aging temperature on microstructure and tensile properties of Inconel 718 fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Samples were subjected to different aging temperatures and characterized by microstructure analysis and tensile testing.
summary_en.result: Aging temperature significantly influenced precipitation phases and tensile properties.
summary_en.validation: Validation via tensile tests and microstructure observation.

papers.title: Numerical modelling of parts distortion and beam supports breakage during selective laser melting (SLM) additive manufacturing
papers.first_author_affiliation: Halbronn, Z.I. Lognes, rue des Campanules, Marne-La-Vallée, 77437, France

corresponding_authors.name: Y. Bresson
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Halbronn, Z.I. Lognes, rue des Campanules, Marne-La-Vallée, 77437, France

papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于SLM工艺中的变形和支撑断裂模拟，未涉及生物医学植入物的力学性能、应力屏蔽或多孔结构设计。
llm.why_not_core: Does not cover biomedical implants, porous structures, stress shielding, mechanical testing, fatigue, or osseointegration; focuses purely on SLM process simulation.

summary_zh.motivation: 模拟选区激光熔化过程中零件变形和支撑断裂
summary_zh.method: 建立热-力学数值模型预测变形和支撑失效
summary_zh.result: 模型可预测变形趋势和支撑断裂位置
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验案例验证数值预测准确性

summary_en.motivation: To predict part distortion and support breakage during selective laser melting additive manufacturing.
summary_en.method: A thermomechanical numerical model is developed to simulate the SLM process and predict distortion and support failure.
summary_en.result: The model successfully predicts distortion patterns and identifies locations of support breakage.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing numerical predictions with experimental measurements of distortion and support integrity.
